env TARGET=$WORK/.codex/skills
env SRC=$WORK/source

# Install only skill_a
exec axen source add $SRC -n source
exec axen install source --targets=codex --skills=skill_a

# Check that only skill_a was installed
exists $TARGET/skill_a/SKILL.md
! exists $TARGET/skill_b/SKILL.md

-- source/skill_a/SKILL.md --
name: skill_a
-- source/skill_b/SKILL.md --
name: skill_b
-- source/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "mysrc", "skills":{"skill_a":{"path":"skill_a"},"skill_b":{"path":"skill_b"}}}
